name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 13 – Am 65
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 13b. Demands the mandatory application of accelerated return procedures for foreign preachers or religious figures flagged for radicalisation; insists that any rejection of such applications must immediately be followed by expedited return, ensuring that individuals posing a threat to national security cannot remain within the EU;
